codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly upgrades the Daytona SDK dependency from >=0.167.0 to >=0.168.0 in pyproject.toml, with corresponding uv.lock updates. The worker thoroughly verified that the codebase was already fully snake_case compliant — no camelCase attribute access on Daytona SDK objects was found, and all Daytona class instantiations use snake_case kwargs. The change is minimal and precise: only pyproject.toml and uv.lock were modified. All verification steps pass on the current branch.
